verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a Web API whose docs live under a versioned path (/api/v1/docs), which suggests a versioned API surface. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a changelog, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning documentation beyond the URL path, a changelog or sunset notices, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
